karmas.text: If a player would execute a demand effect against you, first execute that demand effect yourself on that player.
Each {[AUTHORITY]} on your board provides one additional {[AUTHORITY]} and one additional {[INDUSTRY]}.
Each {[AUTHORITY]} on an opponent's board subtracts one point from that opponent's score.
You may issue a War Decree with any two figures.
Each card in your hand provides one additional point towards your score.
If you would meld a non-figure with a Meld action, instead self-execute it.
If you would tuck a sixth card or score a sixth card this turn, first draw and achieve a [1].
If you would draw a [1] during your first action, first draw and score a card of value equal to the number of [1] in your hand.
You may issue an Expansion Decree with any two figures.
If you would meld a card, first draw and tuck a [2]. If the tucked card has no {[AUTHORITY]}, return it.
If you would draw a card of value higher than 1 and you have a [1] in your hand, first return all cards from your hand and draw a card of that value for each card you return.
You may issue a Trade Decree with any two figures.
If you would draw a card during your first action, first draw and score a [2].

cards.title: SARGON OF AKKAD

karmas.text: If you would not be eligible for sharing, instead become eligible for sharing and junk an available achievement of value 1.

cards.appendix: This Karma effect triggers the moment sharing eligibility is determined.

karmas.text: Each unsplayed color on your board adds one to the value of your highest top card for the purpose of claiming achievements.

If you would dogma a [1] as your second action, first draw and meld a [2], then splay left the color of the melded card on your board. If you do both, and the melded card was a [2], return the top card of that color from all boards.

cards.title: HUANG DI

karmas.text: You may issue an Advancement Decree with any two figures.
If you would dogma a card using {[HEALTH]} as a featured icon, first draw a [2].

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

cards.title: PTAHHOTEP

karmas.text: If you would dogma a card as your second action, instead score a card from your hand. If you do, super-execute the scored card.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

karmas.text: You may issue a Rivalry Decree with any two figures.
Each {[AUTHORITY]} on your board provides one additional point towards your score.

cards.title: HOMER

karmas.text: If you would dogma a card of a color, first draw and tuck a [2], then return your top card of the drawn card's color if it is different.
If you would junk or return a figure from your hand, instead tuck it.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

karmas.text: You may issue a War Decree with any two figures.
If you would draw for a share bonus, first meld any number of cards from your hand having the Dogma action's featured icon.
When you meld this card, score all opponents' top figures.
If you would take a Dogma action, first draw and score a [2]. If it isn't a [2], score Alexander the Great.
You may issue an Expansion Decree with any two figures.
If you would issue a Decree, first junk all cards from all opponents' hands.
If a player would score a card, first splay all colors on your board left.
Each top card on your board of a color not splayed counts as an available achievement for you.
You may issue a Trade Decree with any two figures.
Each top blue card on every player's board counts as a card you can activate with a Dogma action.

cards.title: AUGUSTUS CAESAR

karmas.text: If a player would dogma a card with {[AUTHORITY]}, instead draw and reveal a card of the same value. If it has {[AUTHORITY]} or {[CONCEPT]}, meld it. Otherwise, the player super-executes the original card.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

karmas.text: You may issue an Advancement Decree with any two figures.
If you would execute an effect, first increase every [ ] value in the effect by one for the duration of the effect.
If a player would claim an achievement, first draw and tuck a [3], then score all cards above the tucked card.

cards.title: CONFUCIUS

karmas.text: If you would dogma a card using {[AUTHORITY]} as a featured icon, instead score the card and junk all cards in the [2] deck or the [3] deck.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

cards.title: PLATO

karmas.text: You may issue a Rivalry Decree with any two figures.
If you would dogma a card as your first action, first splay the card's color left. If you don't, junk an available achievement of value 2.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

karmas.text: If you would draw a [3], first score a top red card of value less than 4 from anywhere.
Each two {[AUTHORITY]} on your board provides one additional icon of every other standard icon type on your board.

cards.title: SALADIN

karmas.text: You may issue a War Decree with any two figures.
If you would dogma a card with a demand effect, instead score a top card with {[AUTHORITY]} of each color on each opponent's board.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

cards.title: AVICENNA

karmas.text: You may issue an Expansion Decree with any two figures.
If you would dogma a card as your first action, instead junk the lowest available standard achievement, then super-execute the junked card.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

karmas.text: If you would draw a card, first tuck a card of the same value from your hand or from an opponent's score pile.
If you would score a non-figure of a color or splay a color of your cards left, instead splay that color right.
Each visible card on your board provides an additional point towards your score.
You may issue a Trade Decree with any two figures.
If you would meld a card, first draw and meld a [3]. If the drawn card has no {[HEALTH]}, return it.
If you would take a Draw action, instead tuck a top card with {[AUTHORITY]} from anywhere. Then draw a card of value equal to the number of {[AUTHORITY]} or {[CONCEPT]} in a color on your board.
You may issue an Advancement Decree with any two figures.
If you would meld a card of value equal to your top red card, instead return it and draw and meld a card of value one higher.
You may issue a Rivalry Decree with any two figures.
If you would claim a standard achievement, first you may achieve a card from your score pile if eligible for both without its points.
If you would draw a card for sharing, first draw two cards of the same value.
If another player would draw a card for sharing, first score a card from your hand.

cards.title: AMINA SUKHERA

karmas.text: If you would dogma a card as your second action, first score a figure from an opponent's hand.
Each top card with {[AUTHORITY]} on your board counts as an available achievement for you.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

karmas.text: If any player would transfer a card or exchange any number of cards, instead tuck that card or those cards, draw and tuck a [4], and score a top card with {[AUTHORITY]} from anywhere.
If you would meld a card, first meld another card in your hand. If the other card is purple, draw three [4], then score a top figure from anywhere.
Each card in your hand is also considered part of your score pile.
If you would draw a card, first junk all cards in either the [4] or [5] deck.
If you would meld a card, first junk an available achievement of value 3, 4, or 5.
You may issue a Trade Decree with any two figures.
If you would dogma a [1], instead claim the World achievement. If you don't, and Monotheism is a top card on your board, you win.
You may issue an Advancement Decree with any two figures.
If you would take a Draw action, instead draw and reveal a [5], and splay its color on your board right. If the drawn card has {[CONCEPT]}, meld it.
If you would take a Dogma action, instead do so while increasing each [ ] value in every effect during this action by the number of different top card values on your board greater than 3.
Each color splayed right on only your board counts as an achievement for you.
If you would splay a color on your board, first unsplay that color on all opponents' boards.
You may issue a Rivalry Decree with any one figure.
You may issue any Decree with any three figures.
If an opponent would claim an achievement, first you claim another available standard achievement if eligible.
If you would dogma a yellow card, first transfer all purple cards on your board to the available achievements.
You may issue a War Decree with any two figures.
If you would return a card, first score your bottom green card. If the scored card has {[PROSPERITY]}, achieve your bottom green card, if eligible.
Each card in your hand counts as ten points towards the cost of claiming an achievement of that card's value.
If you would draw a card, first you may return a [5] from your hand. If you do, draw a [6].
You may issue an Expansion Decree with any two figures.
Each {[INDUSTRY]} on your board provides one additional point towards your score for every achievement you have.
If you would draw a fifth card into your hand, first claim an available achievement of that card's value or below, regardless of eligibility.
If you would draw a first card into your hand, first draw a [6].
If you would take a Draw action, instead score a top card with {[PROSPERITY]} from anywhere.
If you would draw a card, first claim an available achievement matching that card's value regardless of eligibility.

cards.title: ISAAC NEWTON

karmas.text: If you would take a Draw action, first draw a [1] and transfer it to any player's board.
If you would dogma a card, first splay right every color on your board with a top card of that card's value.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

cards.title: CHRISTIAAN HUYGENS

karmas.text: If you would dogma a card as your first action, instead junk all cards in the [6] deck. Then draw and reveal one [7], two [8], or three [9]. If the drawn cards have more {[EFFICIENCY]} than you have on your board, return them.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

karmas.text: If you would meld a fifth visible card of a color on your board, first claim an available achievement regardless of eligibility.
If you would claim a standard achievement, first claim an available achievement of value one higher, regardless of eligibility.
If you would meld a card, first score all cards of a color on your board.
You may issue a War Decree with any two figures.
If you would meld, tuck, score, or return a card, instead meld it, then if the melded card is red or blue, tuck it. Score a top card of value 5 or 6 from anywhere.
If you would meld a card, first choose a value. Return a top card with {[INDUSTRY]} of the chosen value from each player's board. Junk an available achievement of the chosen value.
You may issue an Expansion Decree with any two figures.
Each top card with {[INDUSTRY]} on your board counts as an available achievement for you.
If a player would execute a demand effect against you, instead return a card from your hand.
If an opponent would score a card, first junk an available achievement of the same value.
Each {[PROSPERITY]} on your board provides two additional {[PROSPERITY]}.
If you would take a Dogma action with no player eligible to share, first junk all cards in the [6] deck. If you don't, splay one color of your cards right.
You may issue a Trade Decree with any two figures.
If you would take a Draw action, first return a card from your hand. If you do, draw a card from any set of value equal to the returned card.
If you would meld a card, first choose a value and meld all other cards of that value from your hand and score pile.
If you would take a Draw action, first draw a [7].
You may issue an Advancement Decree with any two figures.
If you would meld a card, first if there is a top figure of the same color on any opponent's board, transfer that figure to your hand.
Each {[CONCEPT]} on your board provides one additional {[CONCEPT]} and one additional {[EFFICIENCY]}.
If a player would meld a card, first that player transfers their top card of the same color into their hand.
You may issue a Rivalry Decree with any two figures.
If you would score a card, first junk all cards from your score pile, then draw and score four [5]. If you score only [5]s, draw and score four [5].

cards.title: ROBERT E. LEE

karmas.text: If a player would dogma a card with a demand effect, first transfer a top card of another color with {[HEALTH]} from anywhere to any player's board.
Each seven {[HEALTH]} on your board counts as an achievement.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

If an opponent would draw a card, first draw and tuck a [7].

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

If a player would transfer, return, score, meld, or junk a card from your score pile, instead leave it there.

karmas.text: If you would dogma a card of a color you have splayed right, first splay that color on your board up.
If you would claim an achievement, first transfer the bottom yellow card on each board to the available achievements.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

karmas.text: Each standard icon type on your board counts as an achievement, if you have at least twice as many of that icon as every opponent.
If a player would transfer a card, first junk all cards in the [7] deck.
You may issue an Advancement Decree with any two figures.
If you would claim an achievement, first if no opponent has more achievements than you, you win. Otherwise, draw an [8].
Each card in your hand provides one additional standard icon of every type on your board.
If a player would return a card of value lower than 8, first draw an [8].
If you would meld a [10] and you have top cards of five unique values on your board, instead you win.
Until your second action on your turn, each card in an opponent's hand counts as being in your hand.
You may issue a Rivalry Decree with any two figures.
If you would score a card, first choose a figure in any score pile. Choose to either score it, or transfer it to the available achievements.
You may issue a War Decree with any two figures.
If you would score a non-figure, instead score the top card of its color from all boards, and score a card in any score pile.
If you would draw an [8], first junk all cards in the [8] deck.
If you would meld a card, instead meld it and self-execute it.

cards.title: CARESSE CROSBY

karmas.text: If a player would dogma a card of a color you do not have splayed left, first splay that color on any board left and draw two [2]. If you splay a fifth color left on your board this way, you win.

cards.title: J.P. MORGAN

karmas.text: You may issue a Trade Decree with any two figures.
If a player would dogma a card, first splay the color of the card up on your board.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

karmas.text: Each {[EFFICIENCY]} on your board provides an additional number of points equal to the number of {[EFFICIENCY]} on your board.
If a player would score a card, first junk a card from that player's score pile.
Each different value present in your score pile above 6 counts as an achievement.
If you would draw a card of a value not present in your hand, first draw a [9].
You may issue an Advancement Decree with any two figures.
If you would take a Draw action, first meld all cards with {[CONCEPT]} or {[EFFICIENCY]} from each player's hand.

cards.title: H.G. WELLS

karmas.text: If you would dogma a card using {[CONCEPT]} as a featured icon, instead draw and junk a [10], then super-execute the junked card.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

karmas.text: If you are required to fade a figure, instead do nothing.
If you would meld a figure and have at least four top figures already, instead you win.

cards.title: NELSON MANDELA

karmas.text: If you would dogma a card as your second action, instead super-execute the card.
Each two {[AVATAR]} on your board counts as an achievement.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

karmas.text: If an opponent would meld a card, first choose a top red card on an opponent's board. Choose to either score it, or self-execute it.
If you would meld a card, first meld all other cards of that color from each player's hand, then draw and achieve a [9] for each card you meld in this way, regardless of eligibility.
If you would meld a card, first draw and score a [9]. If the scored card is yellow, junk all cards in all score piles and all available achievements.
Each special achievement is claimed with one fewer or one lower of each requirement listed for you.
If you would claim an achievement, first splay a color of your cards up.

cards.title: TAIICHI OHNO

karmas.text: If you would dogma a card, first you may achieve a card from your hand with featured icon matching that card's featured icon, regardless of eligibility. If you don't, draw an [11].

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

karmas.text: If an opponent would not draw a card for sharing after a Dogma action, first draw and reveal a [10]. If the revealed card is blue, you win.
If a player would draw a figure, first junk all cards in the [9] or [10] deck.
Each valued card in the junk counts as being in your score pile.
You may issue a Rivalry Decree with any two figures.
If you would score a card, first if both your top yellow card and your top green card are highest top cards on your board, you win.
If a player would transfer, return, draw, score, meld, tuck, or junk a card of value less than 4, instead that player loses.
If an opponent would win, first score all other top figures anywhere. If you now have the most points, you win instead.
If you would draw a card, first score a figure from your hand.
You may issue a War Decree with any two figures.
If you would take a Dogma action, first score any top card with {[PROSPERITY]} or {[INDUSTRY]} from anywhere.

If you would draw a card and have no figures in hand, first say “Who is” and name a figure. Search the figures deck of any age for the named figure and transfer it into your hand if present. Then shuffle that deck.

cards.title: SHIGERU MIYAMOTO

karmas.text: If you would dogma a card using {[EFFICIENCY]} as the featured icon, first if you have exactly one, three, or six {[EFFICIENCY]} on your board, you win.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

karmas.text: You may issue a Trade Decree with any two figures.
If a player would take a Dogma action, first you may return your bottom green card. If you do, you have sole majority in every icon during the action.

cards.title: SERGEY BRIN

karmas.text: Each top card on every player's board counts as a card you can activate with a Dogma action.
If you would dogma a card on another player's board, first splay its color up on your board.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

karmas.text: If another player would not draw a card for sharing after a Dogma action, or you would draw a card for sharing, first self-execute the card activated by the Dogma action.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

cards.title: MARTIN SCORSESE

karmas.text: If you would meld a figure, instead tuck the figure and claim an achievement, regardless of eligibility.

If you would execute a dogma effect, first return any number of cards from your hand. If you do, execute that dogma effect an additional time for every card you return, then draw an [11].

cards.title: SHEIKH TAMIM

karmas.text: If you would dogma a card using a featured icon, first you may return a card from your hand with that icon. If you do, issue a Decree of color matching the color of the returned card.

cards.appendix: "Dogma a card" is equivalent to "Take a Dogma action and choose a specific card"

karmas.text: If a player would dogma a card, first junk another top card with {[INDUSTRY]} from any board. Then if there is no top card with {[INDUSTRY]} on any board, you win.

karmas.text: If an opponent would take a Dogma action, instead the opponent draws, reveals, and returns a card of any value. The opponent super-executes their top card of the revealed card's color, if there is one.
When you meld this card, junk all cards that are not achievements or in decks. Introduce the [0] deck. Draw a [0].
If you would draw a card, first choose a value and return all cards of that value from all score piles. If you return exactly one card, achieve it, regardless of eligbility.
If you would execute a dogma effect, first draw and score a [9].
If you would take a Dogma action as your second action, instead super-execute each of your top cards, if you have one, in red, blue, green, yellow, purple order.
When you meld this card, unsplay all colors on all boards.
If a player would meld a card, first return their top six cards of its color. If you don't, that player scores all cards of its color from all boards.

If you would take a Draw action, instead reveal the top card of five decks, one at a time. If you reveal five colors, you win. Otherwise, draw one of the revealed cards, and splay aslant a color on your board.

Score a card with a {[FOOD]} on your board. If you do, meld a card from your hand for each {[FOOD]} on the scored card.

Draw a [0]. If it has no {[FOOD]}, you may reveal it, score it, and draw a [0].
I DEMAND you draw and reveal two [0]! Transfer the card of my choice to my board!
I DEMAND you reveal a card in your hand of color not on my board or of value greater than 0! If you don't, you lose!
Meld a card from your hand of color on your board. If you don't, you lose.
I DEMAND you draw, reveal, and return a [0]! Transfer your top card of the color of the revealed card to my board!
If Skinning is a top card on your board, draw a [1].
I DEMAND you reveal your hand and all cards in my score pile! Transfer all cards in your hand of the colors of the cards in my score pile to my hand!
If you have five top cards of value 0 on your board, you win.
Score two cards from your hand.
Transfer a card from your score pile to another player's board. If you do, meld that player's bottom card of the transferred card's color.
Draw two [0]. Return one of them.
Score another top card with a {[FOOD]} on your board. If you don't, you lose.
You may exchange all cards in your hand with all the highest cards in an opponent's score pile.
Return a top card from your board. Draw a [0]. Reveal your hand. If you have exactly one card in your hand of the color of the returned card, meld it. Otherwise, you lose.
Reveal a card in your score pile of a color on your board. If you do, draw a [1].
